passage.text: Flu season is here, and a lot of students are sick.
passage.reading: ˈfluː ˌsiːzən ɪz ˈhɪr, ənd ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈstuːdənts ər ˈsɪk.

passage.text: You can catch the flu in class, on the bus or at the mall.
passage.reading: juː kən ˈkætʃ ðə ˈfluː ɪn ˈklæs, ɑːn ðə ˈbʌs ɔːr ət ðə ˈmɔːl.

passage.text: Wash your hands before you eat.
passage.reading: ˈwɑːʃ jʊr ˈhændz bɪˈfɔːr juː ˈiːt.

passage.text: Cover your mouth when you cough or sneeze.
passage.reading: ˈkʌvər jʊr ˈmaʊθ wɛn juː ˈkɔːf ɔːr ˈsniːz.

passage.text: A mask can help on busy buses and trains.
passage.reading: ə ˈmæsk kən ˈhɛlp ɑːn ˈbɪzi ˈbʌsɪz ənd ˈtreɪnz.

passage.text: If you have a fever, stay home and rest.
passage.reading: ɪf juː ˈhæv ə ˈfiːvər, ˈsteɪ ˈhoʊm ənd ˈrɛst.

passage.text: Our nurses are here from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday to Friday.
passage.reading: aʊər ˈnɜːrsɪz ər ˈhɪr frəm ˈeɪt ˌeɪˈɛm tə ˈfaɪv ˌpiːˈɛm, ˈmʌndeɪ tə ˈfraɪdeɪ.
